correctness.rationale: Write S=P/2=a+b, t=ab, theta=asin(A/t), with exact feasible interval A<=t<=S²/4. The support-width formula W(phi)=a|cos phi|+b|cos(phi-theta)| yields E W²=S²/2+t(2g(theta)-1), g=[sin theta+(pi/2-theta)cos theta]/pi. Its derivative H(theta)=2/pi[sin theta+(pi/2-theta)/cos theta]-1 is positive and increases with theta; because theta decreases in t, F(t) is strictly increasing and concave. Endpoint derivatives H(pi/2)=4/pi-1 and H(asin(4A/S²)) are sharp. Rectangle (t=A) and rhombus (t=S²/4) exhaust extrema; a=b and theta=pi/2 uniquely for delta=1. Independent numeric recomputation confirmed monotonicity, concavity, and derivative endpoint inequalities for three shape families. Read verify.py from exact blob: seeded quadrature/bisection spot checks only, not an infinite proof.
